title: 第一卷 第1320章 万古墓第一卷 第1319章 臣妾冤枉
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：九天轮回诀第一卷第1320章万古墓！
（..la）而龙孙腰间的那个长长的宝盒虽然模样跟月光宝盒有一些相似的模样，但是却通体是紫色的。
吴刚扛着自己的大斧咧嘴一笑，并未反对，饶是张三丰，这个邋遢随性的人也点头了，前些日子的那一战可见真的让他打出真火来了。
“竟然是水龙殿的人，这下有好戏看了。”
一个青年望着这边，脸上露出微笑。
“不用多说，我已知尔等来意，回去后囤积兵马粮草，来年贫道会来助你一臂之力。”
卧南道人说道。
二人还没冲出去几步，就再也冲不动了，不由回头惊诧一望，却是王昊将他们拉住。
黄汹涌走后，东门博弈就指着封林，唾沫星子乱飞，喷封林一脸。
“这都是些微末本事，你既是天生石猴，当知我为天，你的生命也是我赐予。”
王昊笑道。
“待俺老孙一试。”
孙悟空说道，气沉泥丸宫，全身法力调动，竟不能动其分毫。
他的精神能力猛地一把涌入冰魄龙脑袋中，刚想挣扎的冰魄龙，目光变得呆滞起来，最后彻底失去焦距。
这可怕的力量，让他内心胆颤！
他从来没有见过那么可怕的力量，就算是他炼灵期六层修为，都做不到这种可怕的爆发。
林东撤掉结界，箭飞脸色凝重地道，他的灵魂已经增强了很多，气势增强了很多，可是刚刚也感觉心惊无比，林东的结界并没有完全抵挡住巨魔的气息。
这次巨型章鱼甚至连惨叫声都没有发出，直接被这太阳般的力量化为灰烬。
没想到郭大勇几人一包炸药将通道的入口炸开来，通道中的密室中果然珍藏着数量不菲的鸦片烟。
赵铁柱心中好像翻了五味瓶，真不是个滋味。
这么大一片血迹铁柱妈居然到现在才看见，弄得赵铁柱都开始怀疑自己究竟是不是亲生的。
苏染染听完，眉头紧紧的皱在一起，竟然是这样的解释？为什么她总觉得哪里不对？
苏染染忽然之间些许的狡猾，躺到苏卿寒身边后，紧紧的抱住了他，脸凑到他的脖子处，轻轻的啄了几下。
“已经回去了，不知道夏川先生问这个干什么？”
赵延河坐在沙发上，略有些惶恐不安。
庞大的金石海龙在二十分钟之后，背上看起来就像是一只巨型的刺猬一样。
就这样，他们一行人大摇大摆地出了玉泽城，直接向十万大山深处走去。
掏出手机，电话打给了祥子，让祥子马上安排人手过来照顾姚淑珍，同时这件事情一定要注意保密，暂时不要让家里人知道。
“让你丫的去就麻溜的去，信不信本少爷踹你！
凌云狠狠瞪了一眼不配合的燕青。
“方法倒是有，但他应该撑不到我们找到相应的人。”

(..la) Although the long treasure box on Longsun's waist looks somewhat similar to the Moonlight Treasure Box, it is entirely purple.
Wu Gang grinned while carrying his big ax and did not object. Even if it was Zhang Sanfeng, this sloppy and casual man also nodded. The battle a few days ago showed that he really got really fired up.
"It turns out to be someone from the Water Dragon Palace. Now we're in for a good show."
A young man looked here with a smile on his face.
"Needless to say, I already know your purpose of coming. When you return, you will stock up on food and supplies for your troops. The Pindao Society will come to help you in the coming year."
Wonan Taoist said.
The two of them had not rushed out a few steps, but they could no longer rush forward. They couldn't help but look back in surprise, but it was Wang Hao who held them back.
After Huang Huangyong left, Dongmen Game pointed at Feng Lin, spittle flew everywhere, and sprayed Feng Lin's face.
"These are all trivial skills. Since you were born as a stone monkey, you should know that I am the heaven, and your life is also given by me."
Wang Hao smiled.
"Let me, grandson, give it a try."
Sun Wukong said, his anger sinking into the Niwan Palace, and all his magic power was mobilized, but he could not move it at all.
His mental ability suddenly poured into the Ice Soul Dragon's head. The Ice Soul Dragon's eyes became dull as he was about to struggle, and finally lost focus completely.
This terrifying power made him tremble with fear!
He has never seen such terrifying power. Even with his sixth-level cultivation in the spirit refining stage, he cannot achieve such a terrifying explosion.
Lin Dong removed the barrier, Jian Fei said solemnly, his soul has been strengthened a lot, his momentum has been enhanced a lot, but he felt extremely frightened just now, Lin Dong's barrier did not completely resist the troll's breath.
This time the giant octopus didn't even scream, and was directly reduced to ashes by the sun-like power.
Unexpectedly, Guo Dayong and several people used a pack of explosives to blow open the entrance of the passage. As expected, a large amount of opium cigarettes was hidden in the secret room in the passage.
Zhao Tiezhu seemed to have turned over the Five Flavors bottle in his heart, it was really not a good feeling.
Tiezhu's mother didn't see such a large bloodstain until now, which made Zhao Tiezhu doubt whether he was his biological child.
After Su Ranran heard this, her brows knitted together tightly. Was this such an explanation? Why does she always feel like something is wrong?
Su Ranran suddenly became a little cunning. After lying down next to Su Qinghan, she hugged him tightly, put her face close to his neck, and pecked him gently a few times.
"I've already gone back. I wonder why Mr. Xia Chuan asks this?"
Zhao Yanhe sat on the sofa, feeling a little worried.
Twenty minutes later, the huge golden stone sea dragon looked like a giant hedgehog on its back.
In this way, a group of them swaggered out of Yuze City and walked directly to the depths of Shiwan Mountain.
He took out his mobile phone and called Xiangzi, asking Xiangzi to immediately arrange for someone to take care of Yao Shuzhen. At the same time, this matter must be kept confidential and his family should not know about it for the time being.
"I told you to go as fast as you can, believe it or not, I will kick you!
? "
Ling Yun glared at Yan Qing who was uncooperative.
"There are ways, but he probably won't be able to support us in finding the right person."
